summary: Tokyo Lifestyle Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing the notice of its 20th Annual General Meeting of Shareholders, a routine meeting notice under Japanese law. The proposals include approval of financial statements, partial amendments to articles of incorporation, appropriation of surplus (including a year-end dividend of JPY1.890 per share), appointment of an accounting auditor, and election of auditors. This is an ordinary shareholder meeting with no special situation event. No special-situation category applies; the filing is purely procedural.
